meta.name: Plated: Martha Bakes
meta.description:
Before it’s plated, the dish has to be created, tasted, and served, but perfection doesn't come easy. Watch top chefs including Gordon Ramsay, chop, sauté, bake and flambé their way to the perfect plate.

Shows: Martha Bakes, Great British Bites, Martha Stewart's Cooking School, Kitchen Nightmares, Last Meals
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
